1343|5751dde2.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1343|5751dde2.text:
Well, if it isn't a young, bristling $c, no doubt drawn here by talk of my exploits in fields of battle!

No time for stories now, for there are great, important deeds that need doing!  So if you're looking for glory, then luck shines on you today...

1416|c14f3f06.name: Grimand Elmore
1416|c14f3f06.text:
If you've come looking for the finest craftsmanship on this or any other continent in the world, then you've come to the right place!

Grimand Elmore, at your service!

1430|0c543544.name: Tomas
1430|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

1572|04178a2e.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
1572|04178a2e.text: Mark my words!  You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

1651|c2467ddc.name: Lee Brown
1651|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

240|3ccc4430.name: Marshal Dughan
240|3ccc4430.text: Ach, it's hard enough keeping order around here without all these new troubles popping up! I hope you have good news, $N...

241|2823b3ed.name: Remy "Two Times"
241|2823b3ed.text: Hey there, friend.  My name's Remy.  I'm from Redridge to the east, and came here looking for business, looking for business.  You got any...got any??

253|e8768bd6.name: William Pestle
253|e8768bd6.text: Aha!  Good day, good day, Master $C!  Come, sit down and have a drink.  You have an enterprising look in your eye, and I think you'll find speaking to me worth your time...

295|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Farley
295|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

514|aa4da6d8.name: Smith Argus
514|aa4da6d8.text: If you'd like to learn how to blacksmith your own weapons and armor, I'd be happy to help.

5504|a2527c6f.name: Sheldras Moontree
5504|a2527c6f.text:
Welcome, my brother.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There will be a time soon where the call of the Emerald Dream will take hold in you.  You will hibernate for many years and walk amongst the purest of forms.  It is there and then that your ultimate training will take place.

68|37e215b2.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|37e215b2.text: Which class trainer are you looking for?

68|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

68|caa7e31c.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|caa7e31c.text: The Park is where you want to go if you are looking for $c trainers. Theridan and Maldryn can usually be found by the moonwell in the center of the district.

106-accept.name: Maybell Maclure
106-accept.text:
Oh, I'm cursed!  My heart belongs to Tommy Joe Stonefield, but our families are bitter enemies.  So I can't see him, even though my eyes ache to gaze upon that handsome face!

Please, take this letter and give it to Tommy Joe.  He's usually at the river to the west of the Stonefield Farm, which is due west of here.
106-accept.title: Young Lovers

106-complete.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
106-complete.text: Ah!  I can't stand us being apart.  I have to see her!!
106-complete.title: Young Lovers

106-progress.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
106-progress.text: You have what??  Maybell is the light of my dull life.  Hurry, let me see her letter!
106-progress.title: Young Lovers

107-accept.name: Gramma Stonefield
107-accept.text:
I bet William Pestle has a potion to unite our two young lovers!

Here, take this note to William.  He's staying at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.
107-accept.title: Note to William

107-complete.name: William Pestle
107-complete.text:
My heart goes out to those two poor souls, Maybell and Tommy Joe.  I remember being young and in love, once.

There must be something I can do to help them!  Let me think...
107-complete.title: Note to William

107-progress.name: William Pestle
107-progress.text: You have a note from "Gramma" Stonefield, eh?  I haven't seen Mildred in years!  I wonder what she has to say...
107-progress.title: Note to William

109-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
109-accept.text: Looks to me you've seen quite a bit of combat in your time, $c.  If you haven't already, you should report to Gryan Stoutmantle.  He heads up the People's Militia, aimed at protecting the farmlands of Westfall.  I bet he could use your help.  You can usually find him in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill, just off the road in the middle of Westfall.
109-accept.title: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle

1097-accept.name: Smith Argus
1097-accept.text:
There's a dwarven weaponsmith in Stormwind, Grimand Elmore, who sent word that he needs help with a delivery.  I believe he wants a package sent to his homeland in the north.

You have a sturdy pair on you!  So if you're interested in some legwork then speak with Grimand.  We could use you down here, but we must also keep our ties strong with the dwarves.

You can find Grimand Elmore at the weapon shop in the Dwarven District of Stormwind, in the northeast section of town.
1097-accept.title: Elmore's Task

1097-complete.name: Grimand Elmore
1097-complete.text: You're here to help with my delivery?  Very good!
1097-complete.title: Elmore's Task

111-accept.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
111-accept.text:
Please, $N, talk with my Gramma.  If anyone can find a way to bring me together with Maybell, she can.

She's inside our house east of here.
111-accept.title: Speak with Gramma

111-complete.name: Gramma Stonefield
111-complete.text:
While our families are feuding, Tommy Joe and Maybell don't have much of a future, but... maybe we can get them together for just a little while.

Hm, what can we do...
111-complete.title: Speak with Gramma

112-accept.name: William Pestle
112-accept.text:
I can make an invisibility liquor for Maybell, so she can slip away from the Maclure Vineyards and go to Tommy Joe.  But to make the Liquor, I need some crystal kelp.

Although the kelp usually grows in the ocean... sometimes murlocs collect it.  See if the murlocs near Crystal Lake have any.  Crystal Lake is just east of Goldshire.
112-accept.title: Collecting Kelp

1338-accept.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1338-accept.text:
There is a dwarven armorsmith whose work I admire greatly.  His name is Furen Longbeard, and his skill is unmatched.  I need a new shield, and I must have one of his!

The problem is... Furen is far to the south, in the dwarven district within Stormwind.  In human lands!  I can't imagine why he would live there, so far from Ironforge.  The humans must pay him a king's ransom to keep him there!

So, if you want to travel and don't mind making some money, then will you send Furen my request for a shield?
1338-accept.title: Stormpike's Order

307-accept.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-accept.text:
The Silver Stream Mine to the east ran dry long ago.  It was converted by the Miners' League into a storage depot, but now Kobolds have moved in, putting their filthy paws on good, Dwarven tools!

We'll root out those vermin soon enough, but the League wants someone to get their gear out of the mine before we warriors tromp in there and break things.  It'll be a tough delve - you might want cohorts at your side.

The gear is stored in Miners' League Crates throughout the mine.  Good luck.
307-accept.title: Filthy Paws

35-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
35-accept.text:
If you are concerned that the rumors of murlocs are true, then do this -- travel to the eastern Elwynn bridge and speak with Guard Thomas.  He has been stationed at the bridge for the past week and will know the state of the area.

Bring me his report.
35-accept.title: Further Concerns

353-accept.name: Grimand Elmore
353-accept.text:
The Stormpikes are a respected dwarven clan, and are well known for their fine and discerning tastes.  So it's no wonder that Gringer Stormpike, a Mountaineer of Ironforge, commissioned me to craft him a weapon.

The weapon is finished, but... Mountaineer Stormpike is far away, in distant Loch Modan.  If you plan on traveling to the north, can you deliver this package to him?

My last message from Mountaineer Stormpike said he's stationed at the northern guard tower in Loch Modan.
353-accept.title: Stormpike's Delivery

353-complete.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-complete.text:
Aha!  So Grimand finally finished my axe!  I can't wait to try it against some troggs and kobolds!

Many thanks, $N.  It was a long distance to travel for this delivery.   Here are some coins for your efforts.
353-complete.title: Stormpike's Delivery

353-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-progress.text: You come all the way from Stormwind?  I hear it's getting dicey down there in the human lands, with brigands and orcs running about.  A perfect place for a $c to prove their worth!
353-progress.title: Stormpike's Delivery

40-accept.name: Remy "Two Times"
40-accept.text:
$N, there's a new threat in Elwynn Forest!  Murlocs are swimming up the streams of eastern Elwynn, scaring away fish and attacking gentle folk!

I warned Marshal Dughan, but he's more worried about the gnolls and the bandits.  He's not convinced that the murlocs are a danger.

Please, $N, speak to Dughan and persuade him to send more troops to the east!
40-accept.title: A Fishy Peril

40-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
40-complete.text:
Yes, I spoke with Remy.  I respect him as a merchant, though all reports of Murlocs to the east have been sketchy at best.

Your concerns are noted, but unless I receive a military report of a murloc threat, we can't afford to send more troops east.
40-complete.title: A Fishy Peril

417-accept.name: Unknown
417-accept.text:
Hildelve wrote in his journal that he was attacked by Mangeclaw, a "huge Ice Claw Bear."  He drove off the beast, but not before it mauled him savagely.

Judging from the state of Hildelve's body, Mangeclaw must have later returned and killed him.

However, Hildelve wrote in his journal his one, final wish:

Revenge against Mangeclaw.
417-accept.title: A Pilot's Revenge

417-complete.name: Pilot Hammerfoot
417-complete.text:
This is grim news, for Hildelve was a good friend.  And I wish I could have been there with you when you found the beast, Mangeclaw!

Thank you, $N.  Your deed will be remembered by the pilots of the Ironforge Siege Brigade.
417-complete.title: A Pilot's Revenge

417-progress.name: Pilot Hammerfoot
417-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Do you have word of my friend Hildelve?
417-progress.title: A Pilot's Revenge

419-accept.name: Pilot Hammerfoot
419-accept.text:
My friend and fellow Siege Engine pilot, Mori Hildelve, is lost in the hills.  We were looking for a rare ore that's needed for a high-grade blastpowder, and during our search he drove his engine up a steep hill and busted it!

Still convinced that ore was in these mountains, Hildelve charged me to guard our engines while he continued on foot, searching.

It's been days, and I've heard some beastly growls in the hills at night.  Mori's tough as nails, but I'm worried.

Please, $N.  Find him.
419-accept.title: The Lost Pilot

419-complete.name: Unknown
419-complete.text:
Here is the corpse of a dwarf -- mauled, frozen, and picked clean by mountain scavengers.  Clutched in its hand is a book containing the roughly scribbled notes of Mori Hildelve.  And around its frame, still in superior condition, is a Brigadier's Vest.

This grisly scene must have been where the Siege Engine pilot met his end.
419-complete.title: The Lost Pilot

47-accept.name: Remy "Two Times"
47-accept.text:
The Kobolds in these parts sometimes carry Gold Dust on them.  I could really use the stuff - bring me a load of it and I'll give you the best price in town...best price in town!

You can find kobolds in the Fargodeep Mine to the south, and around the Jasperlode Mine to the northeast.
47-accept.title: Gold Dust Exchange

47-complete.name: Remy "Two Times"
47-complete.text: Thanks for the dust, $N.  Here's your cash, and...here is a token from associates of mine.  You might find it useful...useful.
47-complete.title: Gold Dust Exchange

47-progress.name: Remy "Two Times"
47-progress.text: Psst!  You have that Gold Dust for me...for me?
47-progress.title: Gold Dust Exchange

60-accept.name: William Pestle
60-accept.text:
Hello, good sir!  Do you have a moment?

My brother and I run an apothecary in Stormwind, and I'm here to gather large candles for their wax.  Can you help me?

You can get large candles from kobolds, and I hear rumors that kobolds are infesting the Elwynn mines ... the Fargodeep mine to the south and Jasperlode Mine to the east.  I suggest looking for candles in one of those places.
60-accept.title: Kobold Candles

60-complete.name: William Pestle
60-complete.text: You were busy hunting kobolds, were you?  Thanks for the candles, $N, and here's your reward...
60-complete.title: Kobold Candles

60-progress.name: William Pestle
60-progress.text: Did you gather those candles yet?
60-progress.title: Kobold Candles

61-accept.name: William Pestle
61-accept.text:
My brother Morgan is waiting in Stormwind for my shipment of candles.  I don't have enough time to make the trip myself, but if you'd like to take him the shipment, he'll pay you well.

I've packed up the candles, and you can find Morgan in our shop, Pestle's Apothecary, in the Stormwind Trade District.
61-accept.title: Shipment to Stormwind

61-complete.name: Morgan Pestle
61-complete.text: Here is your payment ... and while you're here, take a look around!  I'm sure we have a potion or other trinket you'd find useful.
61-complete.title: Shipment to Stormwind

61-progress.name: Morgan Pestle
61-progress.text: Oh, a shipment from my brother?  Splendid!  Fortune truly shines on me today!
61-progress.title: Shipment to Stormwind

62-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
62-accept.text:
The mine in Northshire isn't the only one with problems!  I have reports that the Fargodeep Mine in Elwynn has also become a haven for Kobolds.

Explore the mine and confirm these reports, then return to me.  The mine is almost due south of Goldshire, between the Stonefield and Maclure homesteads.
62-accept.title: The Fargodeep Mine

62-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
62-complete.text: This is bad news.  What's next, dragons?!?  We'll have to increase our patrols near that mine.  Thanks for your efforts, $N.  And hold a moment... I might have another task for you.
62-complete.title: The Fargodeep Mine

76-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
76-accept.text:
Thanks to you we know the Fargodeep Mine is infested with kobolds.  Now we need a scout to investigate the more distant Jasperlode Mine.

Explore Jasperlode and confirm any kobold presence.  To reach the mine, travel east along the road until you reach the Tower of Azora.  From the tower, head north and you'll find the mine in the foothills.
76-accept.title: The Jasperlode Mine

84-accept.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
84-accept.text: Here you go.  And when you give this pie to that Billy, you tell him I hope he chokes on it!
84-accept.title: Back to Billy

84-complete.name: Billy Maclure
84-complete.text:
Mm, yum!  This pie is the best!

I think my memory is coming back to me...
84-complete.title: Back to Billy

84-progress.name: Billy Maclure
84-progress.text: Ugh... I'm starving!  Do you have that pie for me, $N?
84-progress.title: Back to Billy

85-accept.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
85-accept.text:
I lost my necklace, and think that guttersnipe Billy Maclure took it!  He's usually scuttling like a rat around the Maclure vineyards east of here. 

Get my necklace back for me, and you'll warm an old widow's heart.
85-accept.title: Lost Necklace

85-complete.name: Billy Maclure
85-complete.text:
You lost a what?  Well I didn't take no necklace, because I ain't no thief!

I might know who did but...<grin>...I'm too hungry to remember.
85-complete.title: Lost Necklace

86-accept.name: Billy Maclure
86-accept.text:
Maybe if I got a pie, I could tell you who has that necklace.  And you know, I think that old Bernice lady at that other farm makes great Pork Belly Pies... 

Maybe if you gave her some chunks of boar meat from the boars that hang around our farms, and told her what it was for, she'd bake up a pie for you.
86-accept.title: Pie for Billy

86-complete.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
86-complete.text: Though this wild boar meat is tough, simmer it enough and it sure does make for some tasty pie!
86-complete.title: Pie for Billy

86-progress.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
86-progress.text:
I don't think it's right feeding the boy who stole my necklace in the first place, but if that's what it takes to get back what's mine, then so be it!

Do you have that boar meat?
86-progress.title: Pie for Billy

87-accept.name: Billy Maclure
87-accept.text:
I was playing near the Fargodeep Mine, and I think I dropped, er...I mean I saw, the old lady's necklace.  Don't ask me how it got there...it wasn't me!

Well anyway, I saw this big, gold-toothed kobold pick up the necklace and run into the mine.  Go find that kobold and you'll find the necklace, I swear!
87-accept.title: Goldtooth

87-complete.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
87-complete.text:
Oh, you found it!  Thank you, thank you dear!

Here, take this.  It was my husband's and he always said it was lucky.  If only he didn't forget it on his last campaign! *sniff*
87-complete.title: Goldtooth

87-progress.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
87-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you found my necklace?
87-progress.title: Goldtooth

88-accept.name: Ma Stonefield
88-accept.text:
The Brackwells have a prize-winning pig, Princess.  The sow is HUGE, and she got that way from sneaking over here and eating my veggies!

So before she comes to our fields...Princess must die!  Bring me her collar as proof of the deed and I'll give you something for your time!

Princess is usually over at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, to the east and beyond the Maclure farm.  Get her before she gets hungry and comes back here!
88-accept.title: Princess Must Die!

97920-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
97920-accept.text:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
97920-accept.title: Camping 101: Fishing

97920-complete.name: Lee Brown
97920-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Fish Bowl. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97920-complete.title: Camping 101: Fishing

99127-accept.name: Jason Mathers
99127-accept.text:
The fish just ain't biting today, and there's something wrong going on with them. It's not just empty hooks. I haven't seen a single minnow up in the water at all.

Lee here set up some traps overnight. Go check to see if we've at least got some stock there. If you find anything weird, make sure to show me.
99127-accept.title: A Net Disaster

99127-complete.name: Jason Mathers
99127-complete.text: All the traps are like this? Seems our new neighboring nuisances are causing more destruction than we were aware of. I'll go broke if we don't do something about it.
99127-complete.title: A Net Disaster

99128-accept.name: Jason Mathers
99128-accept.text:
This can only be the work of those murlocs on the other side of the lake. They're disgusting little things, with a vicious temper and teeth to match. 

If we let this continue, there won't be any fish to speak of anywhere in this lake. If you could clear them out a bit, it would help me a ton.
99128-accept.title: Slimy Menace

99128-complete.name: Jason Mathers
99128-complete.text: I can hear their warbling from here--it'll be in my nightmares. Well, that should slow them down--although I have no doubt that they'll make up those numbers quickly.
99128-complete.title: Slimy Menace

99129-accept.name: Jason Mathers
99129-accept.text:
Remy mentioned murlocs the other day... I'm pretty sure he hates the little buggers as much as I do. 

He might have some ideas on how to keep them away from my fish in the future. I'd like to ask you to go chat with him and see if there's anything he can think of.
99129-accept.title: A Man About a Murloc

99129-complete.name: Remy "Two Times"
99129-complete.text:
I've been warning the guards about the murlocs. They won't listen.

I have a few ideas on how to get back at those critters. I'll need your help getting what I need for it though.
99129-complete.title: A Man About a Murloc

99130-accept.name: Remy "Two Times"
99130-accept.text:
I've got a few ideas on how to deal with murlocs. And one of those also helps some others in the process.

There's a weed often found on farms in the area called duskweed, and in large quantities the petals are toxic to most animals. If we make some murloc bait with the plant, hopefully that can train those creatures to stay away.

And some farmers get their fields cleared in the process. Truly a win-win... truly a win-win.
99130-accept.title: An Enticing Offer

99130-complete.name: Remy "Two Times"
99130-complete.text:
Give me just a minute...

It's pretty simple bait, but as long as nobody's pet gets into it, it should be safe. Just tell Jason not to eat any of it.
99130-complete.title: An Enticing Offer

99131-accept.name: Remy "Two Times"
99131-accept.text:
Tell Mathers he can come pick up the bait later today. I'll give him the rundown on the proper usage.

Hopefully he'll be able to sell his fish again soon. And we'll have less murlocs in this world.
99131-accept.title: Baited for Success

99143-accept.name: Lee Brown
99143-accept.text:
Those fish men must think like actual fish, right? Which means anything they like, fish will like!

If you rummage through some of their junk and return to me with anything that seems like it would make good bait, I'll reward you.
99143-accept.title: Bottles and Baubles

99143-complete.name: Lee Brown
99143-complete.text:
An interesting collection. These should work well enough!

Here's some of my own older supplies. It should help anyone trying to get their footing in fishing.
99143-complete.title: Bottles and Baubles

99143-progress.name: Lee Brown
99143-progress.text: What did you find? Anything interesting?
99143-progress.title: Bottles and Baubles
